# W05 operation fixtures

`events-v1.json` and `schema19.sql` were generated by the compiled schema-19
binary and `scripts/workspace-operation-smoke.cjs` using isolated synthetic Unix
sockets (`.tools/workspace-operation-test-ekAshy`). They include focus, a graceful
close that remains open through eight observations, and a later close where the
daemon is killed after the effect but before ACK. Restart verifies exact absence
while preserving the uncertain execution history and missing report.

All tasks and window metadata are synthetic. The unowned second window is never
closed or included in task payloads. No real desktop inventory or credential is
included. The schema-18 predecessor fixture is retained in
`../browser-pairing/schema18.sql`; it gains no workspace operation authority on
upgrade. Native golden tests reject foreign actors, attempts, cursors, sources,
focus metadata, and manufactured verification without projection changes.
